concept.title: How This Safety Notice Maintains Itself: A Self-Referential DITA Concept

conbody.p: This topic demonstrates how to create and maintain a reusable safety notice in DITA, including how to update, reuse, and extend it.

note.p: Always disconnect power before servicing. This warning is referenced in other topics using conref.

section.p: How to reuse: Reference this warning in other topics using a conref attribute, e.g.:
How to update: Edit the text inside the note element above. All topics referencing this warning will receive the update automatically.
How to extend: Add new note elements for additional warnings, and document their usage here.
